title: Milestone v0.4.1 Update
message: New milestone release with dynamic brand splash, smooth navigation, and Stitch bento overhaul.
changelog:
• Compact Update Dialog: Scrollable changelog view with optimized typography ensuring 1-tap download access on all screen sizes
• Dynamic Brand Splash: Vector logo with expanding book wings, blooming frosted glass orbs, and specular reflection arcs
• Instant Cold Boot: Aurora ambient window canvas eliminating static startup freeze, paired with parallel Firestore pre-warming
• Glitch-Free Tab Navigation: Staggered dissolve-and-glide transition between Home and Profile eliminating ghosting overlap and visual snap-backs
• Permanent Light Mode: Enforced clean, consistent light mode across all system theme settings
• Profile Bento Revamp: Complete redesign with Google Stitch bento cards, monogram avatar, full 30-school lookup, and lifetime stats
• Companion Ergonomics: Magnetic screen-edge snapping and bottom drag-to-dismiss dock
• Overview & Reading: Shimmer skeleton loading state, TTS speech speed selector (0.75x, 1.0x, 1.25x), PDF page memory & jump-to-page dialog
• Gamification Polish: Top-3 Olympic podium leaderboard with sticky 'You' bar, 2-column Trophy Case, 3D quiz flashcard flip & combo streak multipliers
• Safe Workflows: 4-second Undo SnackBars on deletes, assessment question palette & back-press exit protection
• Educator Console: Quick metrics overview and masked student credentials with 1-tap copy
